rows.organisme: Consiglio Nazionale degli Architetti, Pianificatori, Paesaggisti e Conservatori

alternatives.nom: Inarcassa (caisse de prévoyance des architectes et ingénieurs libéraux)

rows.notes: ~100 provincial orders federated by the CNAPPC; the Albo Unico Nazionale aggregates all iscritti and offers a search by name (403 to robots, but public in a browser). 154,117 = CNAPPC report 2025 (70,473 women / 83,644 men); awn.it says “oltre 155mila”; ACE 2024: 152,000. No bulk export.

rows.organisme: Consejo Superior de los Colegios de Arquitectos de España

alternatives.nom: COAM — Red de arquitectos (colegio de Madrid, annuaire public, >10 000 colegiados)

rows.notes: Colegiación compulsory (Ley 2/1974; visado of projects) through the regional colegios, headed by the CSCAE. PITFALL: no consolidated official figure is published (“no hay un dato oficial” — confirmed); headcount = ACE 2024 estimate (series: 47,600 in 2020, 50,000 in 2022). Public search by name at colegio level; the national Registro (Ventanilla Única) not verified as a public search engine.

28,000 registrants, of whom ~22,000 are active (OA statement, press October 2024, ~800 new entrants a year); ACE 2024: 21,400 ≈ the active ones. Public diretório: search by name, number, regional section, municipality and status. No bulk export.

rows.organisme: Τεχνικό Επιμελητήριο Ελλάδας (Technical Chamber of Greece)
rows.notes: SPECIAL REGIME: architects registered with the TEE ALONGSIDE the engineers — 122,154 members across 15 specialities, of whom 20,236 are “αρχιτέκτονες μηχανικοί” (official page, undated, consulted August 2026). A practising licence plus TEE registration are both compulsory. Public search by name (Μητρώο). The UIA section is the TEE, not SADAS. ACE 2024: 17,000 — the TEE register also counts non-active members.

alternatives.nom: Kamra tal-Periti (chambre professionnelle, membre UIA et ACE)

rows.notes: A unified “perit” profession (architect + civil engineer). Periti Act (Cap. 622, 2021): two lists — Perit Arkitett (1,157 names as at 31 December 2025, counted in the gazette) and Perit Inġinier Ċivili (1,122), with HEAVY overlap (they must not be added together). Nominal lists in the Gazette and as a downloadable PDF. The government site blocks certain user agents. Direct count from the gazette of 06.04.2026 (position as at 31 December 2025), carried out on 5 August 2026: 1,157 Arkitett warrants — the earlier figure of 1,122 corresponded exactly to the Inġinier Ċivili list in the same gazette. 934 periti hold both warrants; 1,345 distinct natural persons; 42 companies (P/44 printed twice). Time series: gazette no. 445 of 26.04.2022 (Kap. 390, the SINGLE list predating the split), counted on 5 August 2026 — 1,157 named warrants, 1,156 individuals as at 31 December 2021, plus 15 warrants carrying a number only; that is, 1,156 individuals (2021) → 1,345 (2025).

alternatives.nom: Cyprus Architects Association — « Μητρώο Αρχιτεκτόνων » public

rows.notes: Registration with the ETEK by branch (architecture) is compulsory; public catalogue of members. No per-branch statistic found → headcount = ACE 2024 (revised from 950 to 3,000 in 2022 after realignment with the ETEK register). CAUTION: the UIA section is the Cyprus Civil Engineers & Architects Association (CCEAA), not the ETEK.

rows.organisme: Ordine degli Ingegneri e degli Architetti della Repubblica di San Marino
rows.notes: A joint order of engineers + architects (Decreto 63/1995). The albo is public online and can be filtered: 90 iscritti, of whom 45 are “Architetto” (count of August 2026). A special albo for non-residents. Not in the UIA and out of ACE scope.

No professional order and no state register: “arkitekt” is NOT a protected title. Only the membership titles “Arkitekt SAR/MSA” (SIR, LAR, FPR) are protected, through the association. 14,022 members in September 2025 = architecture + interior + landscape + urban design, students included; 10,028 full members; ~90% of the profession. ACE 2024: 7,600 building architects. No public directory of individuals.

“Arkitekt” is not protected (snl.no: “ingen beskyttet tittel”); only the academic degree is. MNAL = NAL membership. ~4,400 members (2024), of whom ~500 are students. PITFALL: the “sentral godkjenning” (DiBK) approves COMPANIES, not individuals. ACE 2024: 4,700. Other lists: Arkitektbedriftene (employers), AFAG (trade union).

alternatives.nom: Arkitektforeningen — « Find et medlem » (annuaire public des MAA)

rows.notes: “Arkitekt” is unrestricted (the association’s FAQ); “arkitekt MAA” is the de facto protected title. “Cirka 6 000 medlemmer” (website, undated, consulted August 2026). The members’ directory can be searched. ACE 2024: 10,300 (includes non-MAA architects). Others: FAOD (trade union), Danske Arkitektvirksomheder (employers).

alternatives.nom: FISE Oy — registre volontaire de compétences du bâtiment (consultable publiquement)

rows.notes: The profession is unregulated: neither a protected title nor compulsory registration — the designer’s competence is checked PROJECT BY PROJECT by the permit authority. FISE Oy maintains a public voluntary register (76 competence titles). “3 900 arkkitehtia ja arkkitehtiopiskelijaa” (SAFA website, students included, undated); ACE 2024: 3,900 as well.

rows.organisme: Ministry of Industry — löggilding of the title “arkitekt” (Act no. 8/1996); HMS for the löggilding of designers

alternatives.nom: Arkitektafélag Íslands (AÍ) — association (hébergée par Miðstöð hönnunar og arkitektúrs)

rows.notes: A Nordic EXCEPTION: the title “arkitekt (húsameistari)” IS protected (Act 8/1996, verified on althingi.is) — ministerial authorisation, and art. 6 requires a register of those authorised, which was not found online. In parallel, the HMS issues the löggilding of designers (Act 160/2010) — hms.is returned 429 when tested. No official headcount published; AÍ ≈ 400 members (association content, undated). Out of ACE scope.

rows.organisme: Eesti Arhitektide Liit — awarding body for the “volitatud arhitekt” qualification, certificates held in the Kutseregister (state register)

alternatives.nom: EAL — liste nominative publique des membres (~900 tegevliikmed)

rows.notes: The title is not protected, but the ehitusseadustik requires a qualification (volitatud arhitekt tase 7/8, awarded by the EAL) in order to take responsibility for a design → registration compulsory in order to PRACTISE under one’s own responsibility. Certificates can be consulted in the public Kutseregister; no export verified. Headcount = ACE 2024. Absent from the list of UIA sections (verified).

rows.organisme: Certification by the centre of the Latvijas Arhitektu savienība; state register of būvspeciālisti in the BIS (Būvniecības valsts kontroles birojs)

alternatives.nom: Latvijas Arhitektu savienība (association + centre de certification)

rows.notes: A practice certificate is compulsory for independent practice (MK 169 of 20.03.2018); certification delegated to the LAS, public state register in the BIS. BEST CASE IN EUROPE: CC0 open data, daily CSV (33,182 rows across all specialities) — count of 5 August 2026: 1,970 “Arhitekta prakse” rows, of which 758 are active certificates = 754 individuals. ACE 2024: 800 — consistent. What is reserved is independent practice, not the title.

rows.organisme: Lietuvos architektų rūmai (Lithuanian Chamber of Architects)

alternatives.nom: Lietuvos architektų sąjunga (union de création, distincte de la Chambre)

rows.notes: A chamber under public law (Act of 2006) for CERTIFIED architects — attestation and membership required for reserved acts (Architektūros įstatymas, 2017). Nominal list no. 247 of 25.06.2026 in PDF (272 pp., qualifications and sanctions): 1,392 attestations counted. No interactive search engine — a downloadable list only. ACE 2024: 1,300 — consistent. Absent from the UIA sections. Direct count of the sąrašas (272-page PDF) on 5 August 2026: the numbered Atestatas come to exactly 1,392; in all, 1,465 attestations for 1,463 individuals (including EU recognitions and rows with no type).
